# Psalm 104 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Bless O-my-soul YHWH. O-YHWH my-God you-are-very-great; splendor and-majesty you-have-clothed.

**2** Wrapping light as-a-garment, stretching-out the-heavens like-a-curtain.

**3** The-one-laying-beams in-the-waters his-upper-chambers, the-one-making the-clouds his-chariot, the-one-walking on wings-of the-wind.

**4** Making his-angels winds, his-ministers fire flaming.

**5** He-founded the-earth on its-foundations; not it-will-be-moved forever and-ever.

**6** The-deep like-a-garment you-covered-it; above the-mountains stood the-waters.

**7** At your-rebuke they-fled; at-voice-of your-thunder they-hurried-away.

**8** They-went-up mountains, they-went-down valleys, to the-place which you-founded for-them.

**9** A-boundary you-set not they-will-cross; not they-will-return to-cover the-earth.

**10** The-one-sending springs into-the-valleys; between the-mountains they-flow.

**11** They-give-drink-to every beast-of the-field; break the-wild-donkeys their-thirst.

**12** Above-them birds-of the-heavens dwell; from-between the-branches they-give voice.

**13** Watering mountains from-his-upper-chambers; from-fruit-of your-works is-satisfied the-earth.

**14** Causing-to-grow grass for-the-cattle, and-vegetation for-labor-of man, to-bring-forth bread from the-earth,

**15** And-wine that-gladdens heart-of man, to-make-shine the-face with-oil, and-bread the-heart-of man sustains.

**16** Are-satisfied the-trees-of YHWH, the-cedars-of Lebanon which he-planted,

**17** Where birds make-nests; the-stork — the-cypresses her-house.

**18** Mountains the-high for-the-wild-goats; the-rocks a-refuge for-the-rock-badgers.

**19** He-made the-moon for-appointed-times; the-sun knows its-setting.

**20** You-make darkness and-it-is night, in-it creep all beasts-of the-forest.

**21** The-young-lions roaring for-the-prey, and-to-seek from-God their-food.

**22** Rises the-sun, they-gather, and-to their-dens they-lie-down.

**23** Goes-out man to-his-work, and-to his-labor until evening.

**24** How many your-works O-YHWH! All-of-them in-wisdom you-have-made; is-full the-earth of-your-possessions.

**25** This the-sea great and-broad-of hands; there creeping-things and-there-is-no number, living-things small with great.

**26** There ships go; Leviathan this you-formed to-play in-it.

**27** All-of-them to-you look, to-give their-food in-its-time.

**28** You-give to-them they-gather; you-open your-hand they-are-satisfied with-good.

**29** You-hide your-face they-are-troubled; you-gather their-breath they-expire, and-to their-dust they-return.

**30** You-send-forth your-Spirit they-are-created, and-you-renew the-face-of the-ground.

**31** May-be the-glory-of YHWH to-forever; may-rejoice YHWH in-his-works.

**32** The-one-looking to-the-earth and-it-trembles; he-touches the-mountains and-they-smoke.

**33** I-will-sing to-YHWH in-my-life; I-will-sing-praises to-my-God while-I-exist.

**34** May-be-pleasing to-him my-meditation; I will-rejoice in-YHWH.

**35** May-be-consumed sinners from the-earth, and-the-wicked no-more. Bless O-my-soul YHWH. Praise Yah!

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **104:2-4**: Creation imagery paralleling Genesis 1 but in poetic form — light, heavens, waters, winds; God as cosmic architect.

- **104:26**: Leviathan 'to-play in-it' — the fearsome chaos monster is God's plaything; supreme divine sovereignty over chaos.

- **104:29-30**: The cycle of life and death governed by God's ruach ('Spirit/breath') — death is the withdrawal of breath; creation is its bestowal.

— EMET
